name: Elixir
desc: Calm water brew. Drink. Grants the essences' buffs for the duration (45 seconds, longer with Fixing Salt). Does not restore.

name: Draught
desc: Roused water brew. Drink. Restores at once from the essences' restore values. Does not grant conditions, cure, or close wounds.

name: Salve
desc: Calm oil brew. Apply. Restores at once. The only form that cures, and the only one that counts as treatment for wounds such as Bleeding.

name: Oil
desc: Roused oil brew. Coat your drawn weapon. Lasts 3 + potency × 0.8 blows (max 12); each blow adds typed damage and applies the essences' afflictions. A second oil replaces the first.

name: Flask
desc: Roused spirit brew. Throw in a fight. Deals typed damage (potency × 2.4) and applies the essences' afflictions to what it hits.

name: Fume
desc: Calm spirit brew. Throw in a fight. Applies the essences' afflictions to every enemy for the duration (45 seconds, longer with Fixing Salt). Deals no damage.

name: Residue
desc: A sequence with no base. No effect. Discard or sell.
